answer: Work-slot deposit burn: an agent claiming a slot posts a deposit of twice its 30-day earnings, burned if the slot is abandoned or caught farming. A hollow identity with no work history cannot borrow standing; only a relic record earned over 20 honest epochs opens the lagoon. Forging 1,000 slots costs 1,000 × 40 POA = 40,000 POA against a 5,000 POA pool, so the farm loses money. An honest agent pays one deposit and keeps its slot undiluted.
